summary: Z Squared Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Sales Agreement with Roth Capital Partners for an at-the-market (ATM) offering of up to $300 million of common stock under an automatically effective S-3 shelf registration. The agent sells shares on a best-efforts basis on Nasdaq or in negotiated transactions; the company is not obligated to sell. Commission is 3% of gross proceeds. This is a routine capital-raising ATM facility, not a special situation. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring is present.
